source_note: Facts cross-checked against the app's question bank and standard references.

bullets.en: Present simple for habits and facts: She goes to school every day.
bullets.ne: बानी/तथ्यका लागि present simple: She goes to school every day।

bullets.en: Past simple for finished time: They played football yesterday.
bullets.ne: बितेको समयका लागि past simple: They played football yesterday।

bullets.en: Present continuous for 'now': I am doing my homework now.
bullets.ne: 'अहिले' का लागि present continuous: I am doing my homework now।

bullets.en: Subject–verb agreement: singular subject + singular verb (He goes; They go).
bullets.ne: कर्ता–क्रिया मिलान: एकवचन कर्ता + एकवचन क्रिया (He goes; They go)।

bullets.en: Articles: a/an for the first mention of a singular countable noun; the for something specific; an before vowel sounds.
bullets.ne: Articles: एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञाको पहिलो उल्लेखमा a/an; निर्दिष्ट कुराका लागि the; स्वर ध्वनिअघि an।

bullets.en: Prepositions: in (months, years, countries), on (days, dates), at (clock time, exact points).
bullets.ne: Prepositions: in (महिना, वर्ष, देश), on (बार, मिति), at (समय, ठ्याक्कै ठाउँ)।

bullets.en: Active → passive: S + V + O becomes O + be + V3 (+ by S). 'She wrote a letter' → 'A letter was written by her.'
bullets.ne: Active → passive: S + V + O → O + be + V3 (+ by S)। 'She wrote a letter' → 'A letter was written by her.'

bullets.en: Direct → indirect speech: shift the tense one step back. 'I am tired' → He said that he was tired.
bullets.ne: Direct → indirect: काल एक पाइला पछाडि सार्नुहोस्। 'I am tired' → He said that he was tired।

bullets.en: Comparative: -er / more … than. Superlative: the + -est / most.
bullets.ne: तुलनात्मक: -er / more … than। सर्वोच्च: the + -est / most।

bullets.en: Question tags: positive statement → negative tag: 'She is here, isn't she?'
bullets.ne: Question tag: सकारात्मक वाक्य → नकारात्मक tag: 'She is here, isn't she?'

bullets.en: Vocabulary: use roots and prefixes (un-, in-, dis-, re-) to guess meanings; eliminate wrong options first.
bullets.ne: शब्दावली: धातु र उपसर्ग (un-, in-, dis-, re-) बाट अर्थ अनुमान गर्नुहोस्; गलत विकल्प पहिले हटाउनुहोस्।

bullets.en: Spelling: i before e except after c — believe, receive.
bullets.ne: हिज्जे: c पछि बाहेक i, e अघि आउँछ — believe, receive।

bullets.en: First conditional: If + present simple → will + verb. 'If it rains, we will stay home.'
bullets.ne: पहिलो conditional: If + present simple → will + क्रिया। 'If it rains, we will stay home.'
